Peek · Universal Parcel Tracker

Accessibility

This page is about Peek's App Store app, on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Works today

The App Store lists two accessibility features for Peek, on iPhone, iPad and Mac:

  • Differentiate Without Color Alone: every parcel status is written in words, with a symbol, never shown by colour alone.
  • Reduced Motion: with Reduce Motion on, Peek's own animations, the tilt effect and the story that plays by itself on first launch stop. On iPhone and iPad, opening a parcel cross-fades instead of zooming.

In the next update

These fixes are built, but not released yet. They come with the version after 1.1.7.

  • Larger Text: first launch, adding a parcel, the Share extension and pull to refresh grow through the largest text sizes.
  • VoiceOver: archiving, restoring, muting and copying are announced, headings are marked, and full-screen views close with the escape gesture.
  • Voice Control: controls answer to the words they show.
  • Contrast: secondary text has stronger contrast.

Still working on

  • Larger Text: at the very largest sizes, a few screens still overlap on iPhone and iPad.
  • VoiceOver and Voice Control: they need testing on a device before Peek claims them.
  • Dark Interface: Settings has a Dark appearance, but Peek starts light, and the Share extension stays light.
  • Sufficient Contrast: some text, and the Share extension, still fall short.

Report a problem

Write to hello at peektracker.com. Say which device and which screen, and the feature you use, such as VoiceOver or Larger Text.

Bugs also go to Peek's issues on GitHub. Issues are public: leave out real tracking numbers, postcodes and sign-in codes.
